First-person newsletter calls for banning assault rifles (a class ban, the furthest line he names) alongside background checks and safe storage.

rows.reasoning: In his April 2026 newsletter Pierce says the legislature refuses to enact basic laws including "banning assault rifles", which matches "Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons, while allowing other firearms"; he names a ban on one class only, with no call to ban civilian ownership generally. His Nay on HB 1296 (2022), the permitless-carry bill, is consistent but only rules out "Repeal major gun restrictions and let adults carry a firearm without a permit".

quotes.text: Sadly, the legislature refuses to enact even the most basic safety laws like closing loopholes in background checks, instituting safe gun storage requirements and banning assault rifles.
I voted against that law because allowing people to carry concealed weapons without a permit puts Hoosiers at risk.
